sentences.text: 3. Status report / reply be filed before the next date of hearing with an advance copy to the learned counsel for petitioner.

4. Learned counsel for petitioner submits that pursuant to application filed by respondent No. 2 under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. before the learned CMM, directions were issued to SHO, PS: EOW to register an FIR.

Criminal Revision No. 123/2024 against the aforesaid order was preferred on behalf of some of the Directors / accused before learned ASJ, wherein, directions were issued to stay the impugned order dated 18.03.2024 till the next date of hearing.
However, in the meanwhile, FIR was registered by the Police on the night of 22.03.2024 making the aforesaid Revision Petition infructuous.
In the aforesaid background, present petition has been preferred on behalf of petitioner, who is also a Director in EbixCash Limited.
Learned counsel for petitioner emphasizes that proceedings have been mischievously initiated on behalf of respondent Nos. 2 and 3, though disputes are primarily civil in nature.
5. Learned APP for State along with learned counsel for respondent Nos. 2 and 3 vehemently oppose the prayer for interim directions / stay of proceedings.

Learned counsel for respondent Nos. 2 and 3 submits that learned CMM had considered all the relevant issues while passing impugned order dated 18.03.2024 including pendency of arbitration proceedings between the parties and action taken report was also called for and duly considered.
6. Considering the facts and circumstances, no coercive action shall be taken against the petitioner till the next date of hearing.
Further, to avoid any contradictory orders, learned counsel for respondent Nos. 2 and 3 shall bring the present order to the notice of learned ASJ before whom Criminal
